`tolerance=7` and `min_distance=2sl` from the start, with the same round robin history as `steady`, plus bob pinning 2026-09-14 (pre-credited to 35). With a tolerance of a full shift every member within 7 of the lowest score is a candidate, so the order tiebreak rather than the raw score decides among them; `min_distance=2sl` removes anyone with a shift within two shift lengths on either side. For 09-21 carol (current shift) and bob (pin) are too close, so dave (21) is chosen ahead of alice by order after bob; for 09-28 alice; for 10-05 the eligible members are bob (35) and carol (28), both inside the band, and the order walk after alice reaches bob first, so bob is chosen despite the higher score, which is the tolerance effect; carol takes 10-12. No relaxation is needed with four members, so no notes appear.
